The matching estimate of the ATT is about 2452.63. This means the program raises earnings by roughly $2,453 per trainee.

I matched each of the 19 trainees to the non-trainee closest in age, out of 39 non-trainees. Where several non-trainees were equally close in age, I averaged their earnings. I then averaged the earnings differences across the 19 trainees. I did not test whether the estimate is statistically significant.

ANSWER: 2452.63
